text:
alana: quick idea  run a 5-day micro-test for battlecard headlines + routing to see which pulls higher-quality infra leads.

ben: ok what are we testing?

alana: three frames: econ (cost/throughput), reliability (SLOs/fallbacks), portability (hosted->private). two CTAs: Try demo vs Request dedicated.

tori: can we avoid hard %s? say "up to 3x lower serving costs (typical customer)" and call out batching + KV cache.

mike: yep. add a compact benchmark tile in the battlecard: p95/p99 latency ranges + tokens/sec; label as internal tests.

alana: routing plan: econ -> demo sandbox (/w utm), reliability -> contact form, portability -> whitepaper. ops-bot can you create routes?

ops-bot: task created MKG-9331. Routes: /webinar-demo?utm=mk_econ, /webinar-enterprise?utm=mk_rel, /whitepaper?utm=mk_port. Staging links in task.

ben: creative: 2 headlines per frame, 3 hero comps, alt CTAs. small paid test on LinkedIn econ vs reliability, $1k budget.

tori: SDR snippets: short rebut lines for each claim (cost, portability, reliability) <2 sentences. also form should capture lead_type (hosted|dedicated|private).

mike: timeline: headlines + copy Tue EOD, landing up Wed AM, ads Thu. i'll prep dashboard for CTR->MQL and CPL.

alana: perfect. i'll drop a draft battlecard in #marketing Wed morning for quick eyes. :rocket:
